clue.text: Most attractive road in Mediterranean resort

parts.note: Nice is a resort city on the French Riviera
ST is the usual abbreviation for street, a road

explanation.surface: Praise for the loveliest street in a Riviera holiday town.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicest is the superlative of nice, meaning the most pleasant or appealing.

clue.text: Blow £1!

explanation.surface: An exclamation, perhaps, at a punch that costs a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: A smacker is a hearty slap or loud kiss, and also slang for a pound sterling.

clue.text: Therefore, put no male in charge of work study

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep men out of supervising an efficiency study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put' is only a link here, joining the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergonomics is the study of people's efficiency in their working environment.

clue.text: Where little David returns in North America

indicators.note: in means the reversed name sits inside the abbreviation for the continent
returns means the short name for David is read backwards

parts.note: Dave is a short, familiar form of David

explanation.surface: Asking where young David has gone back to in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where' is the whole definition: a US state is a place, answering 'where'. 'returns' turns the short name backwards before 'in' lodges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Nevada is a US state, a place, so it answers the question word for a location.

clue.text: Forces valet to be a comic character

explanation.surface: A soldier's personal servant who turns out to be a cartoon hero.
explanation.definitionFit: A batman is an army officer's servant, and Batman is a DC comics superhero.

clue.text: This produces no capital growth naturally

definitions.text: This produces no capital growth naturally

parts.words: This produces no capital growth naturally
parts.note: capital is the head, and growth is hair, so this is someone whose head grows no hair; the financial reading of capital growth misleads

explanation.surface: Sounds like an investment that yields no gain.
explanation.definitionFit: A person with no hair on the scalp grows nothing on top, the head being one's capital.

clue.text: Note the false incisors

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: false signals the little word the is to be rearranged into a different form

explanation.surface: A remark that someone's front teeth are not real.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' is the sol-fa note, not a written message; 'false' then jumbles the little word that follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Incisors are the cutting front ones among the hard biting structures in the mouth.

clue.text: Put off by article about rest, scoffed

indicators.note: about means the article wraps around the word for resting

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
to lie is to rest
scoffed means ate greedily

explanation.surface: Someone repelled by a piece of writing about relaxing and eating.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate someone is to estrange them, making them turn away.

clue.text: Put into liquidation?

parts.note: read literally as placed into liquid, rather than the business sense of winding up a company

explanation.surface: A company being wound up.
explanation.definitionFit: Something submerged has been plunged into a fluid.

clue.text: Foreign legion's drink

indicators.note: foreign suggests the letters are made strange, rearranged into an unfamiliar order

explanation.surface: The tipple favoured by the Foreign Legion.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the 's of legion's is used as a letter S, part of the fodder LEGIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloe gin is a liqueur made by steeping blackthorn fruit in gin.

clue.text: Old Tayside castle in which Raquel Welch once stayed

indicators.note: in which, with stayed, says the castle's name lodges inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A Scottish castle where a Hollywood star is said to have lodged.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across wELCH Once. Elcho Castle stands near Perth, in the old Tayside region of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Elcho is a sixteenth-century tower house on the River Tay in Scotland.

clue.text: What is a dog-and-a half long and half-a dog high?

definitions.text: What is a dog-and-a half long and half-a dog high?

parts.words: What is a dog-and-a half long and half-a dog high?
parts.note: an old riddle describing a breed with a very long body and very short legs

explanation.surface: A children's riddle about an oddly proportioned hound.
explanation.definitionFit: The German sausage dog breed is notably long-bodied and short-legged.

clue.text: A small weight on the vestment

parts.note: lb is the abbreviation for a pound, a small weight

explanation.surface: A light weight placed on a priest's robe.
explanation.definitionFit: An alb is a long white linen robe worn by clergy at Mass.

clue.text: Dry place for driving off altogether

parts.note: the tee is where a golfer drives off at each hole
altogether means in total

explanation.surface: Describing a golf course spot as completely arid.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry here means abstaining from alcohol, as a lifelong abstainer does.

clue.text: Make effervescent return after a disastrous tea

annotationWithheld.why: Make effervescent return after a disastrous tea (6): A + anagram of TEA gives A...ATE, but nothing gives the remaining ER; 'return' supplies no recognised RE/ER, so the clue as held (OCR) seems garbled
annotationWithheld.clue: Make effervescent return after a disastrous tea

clue.text: Looked on as a bloomer by people in the Alps

definitions.text: Looked on as a bloomer by people in the Alps

parts.words: Looked on as a bloomer by people in the Alps
parts.note: a bloomer suggests a blunder, but here it is a flower that mountain-dwellers see

explanation.surface: Something Alpine folk regard as a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: The white-felted alpine flower is a national symbol in Switzerland and Austria.

clue.text: Inebriated chaps those Sherwood Foresters

explanation.surface: Drunken men who are Robin Hood's outlaw band.
explanation.definitionFit: Merry means tipsy, so tipsy chaps; and Robin Hood's band in Sherwood Forest were his Merry Men.

clue.text: I take one for John in Scotland

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A remark about choosing a single person for a toilet in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Ian is the Scottish form of the given name John.

clue.text: A frenzy of war cries and whirling blades

indicators.note: a frenzy of tells us the letters of the following words are thrown into wild disorder

explanation.surface: Battle shouts mixed with spinning swords in a melee.
explanation.definitionFit: A propeller is a set of rotating blades driving an aircraft.

clue.text: Without a match when it comes to eccentricity

explanation.surface: A lonely bachelor who is also quirky.
explanation.definitionFit: An unpaired sock is said to be the spare one, and strange behaviour is described as peculiar.

clue.text: Italian dynasty uses up most of the remedies

indicators.note: uses up most of says only the early part of the word for remedies survives, the end being consumed

parts.note: medicines are remedies

explanation.surface: An Italian ruling family swallowing nearly all the cures.
explanation.definitionFit: The Florentine banking family ruled Florence and produced popes.

clue.text: Greek letter and French article

parts.note: et is French for and
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A Greek character paired with a French grammar word.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: It is clear that rail services have been cancelled

definitions.text: It is clear that rail services have been cancelled

parts.words: It is clear that rail services have been cancelled
parts.note: a weather forecaster's way of saying the skies are dry, also read as a statement that the trains are off

explanation.surface: An announcement that the trains are not running.
explanation.walkthrough: Clear weather means no rain; add a T and it becomes the sign that no service runs.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as a phrase, it describes a cancelled service and, minus one letter, a cloudless day.

clue.text: Writer dipping bread in drink

indicators.note: in, with dipping, places the bread inside the word for drinking

parts.note: to tope is to drink heavily
a roll is a small loaf of bread

explanation.surface: An author dunking his bread in a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dipping' adds to the picture and acts with 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Trollope was a Victorian novelist, author of the Barsetshire novels.

clue.text: Apply friction to a discord to be played with a flexible tempo

parts.note: to rub is to apply friction

indicators.note: discord suggests the little words are out of harmony, so their letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A musical instruction to rub a jarring chord, played freely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discord' jumbles the letters of 'to' and 'a', here into ATO. The first 'to' and 'be' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, rubato means with the tempo slackened and quickened expressively.

clue.text: Come out for Oriental associate

parts.note: E for East, the Orient
to merge is to join or associate

explanation.surface: An Eastern partner coming out into the open.
explanation.definitionFit: To emerge is to appear from hiding or come into view.

clue.text: Outfit for model with French philosopher

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T
Jean-Jacques Rousseau was an eighteenth-century philosopher writing in French

explanation.surface: Clothing for a fashion model accompanied by a thinker from France.
explanation.definitionFit: A trousseau is the clothes and linen a bride gathers for her marriage.

clue.text: State rank

explanation.surface: Declaring something foul.
explanation.definitionFit: To utter is to say aloud, and utter as an adjective means complete, like rank in rank amateur.

clue.text: Starting point on a Great Lake is weird

parts.note: E, East, is the compass point where the sun rises and the day starts
Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: Something uncanny about the beginning of a big lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Eerie means strange and frightening, uncanny.

clue.text: Loving, but admits to being a conservative

parts.note: I am is how one admits being something
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A romantic who confesses to right-wing politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Amatory describes things relating to sexual love or desire.

clue.text: Putting away the remains in some irritation

indicators.note: in places the remains inside the word for an irritation

parts.note: a sting is a sharp irritation
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: Tidying away cremated remains in an annoyed manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Stashing means hiding or storing something away for later.

clue.text: The boy to become warden

indicators.note: to become signals the letters of the following word change into another

explanation.surface: A lad who grows up to be a guardian.
explanation.definitionFit: Andrew is a common male given name, so a boy.
